releaseTitle: ATalk v3.9.0 — Master Encrypted Chat Backups & Sensory UI Suite
releaseNotes:
• 01 Master Encrypted Chat Backups: Granular chat picking, media type & size filters, AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 encryption, SAF document export & selective restore inspector.
• 02 Top Mini-Capsule HUD: Dynamic island status pill for active VoIP calls, voice note playback, and file transfers.
• 03 Inline Photo Redaction & Privacy Pixelation Brush: In-memory mosaic blur, blackout boxes, and pen markup before zero-trace EXIF stripping.
• 04 2D Inertial Flick-to-Dismiss Media Viewer: Kinetic 2D drag tracking, angular tilt, and velocity momentum fling.
• 05 Logarithmic Rubber-Band Overscroll: Authentic physics dampening with micro-haptic ticks.
• 06 Spring-Zoom Peek & Pop: Long-press message focal zoom with 16dp backdrop blur and reaction shelf.
• 07 Ambient Media Glow: Dynamic chromatic aura projection behind media bubbles via AndroidX Palette.
• 08 Circadian Auto-Redshift: Warm obsidian amber/crimson undertone adjustment between 21:00 and 06:00.
